description: This bar chart illustrates the popularity scores for different large language models across three categories: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The horizontal axis represents the categories, labeled “Movies”, “Songs”, and “Basketball”, appearing in that order from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled “Popularity”, displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 220, with tick marks at intervals of 20.  For each category, there are four bars representing different models: Llama3 (light blue), ChatGPT (orange), Acc=0 & GT Ans (blue, patterned), and Acc=1 & GT Ans (red, patterned). The Llama3 bars have approximate heights of 24 for Movies, 56 for Songs, and 186 for Basketball. The ChatGPT bars are approximately 30 for Movies, 64 for Songs, and 162 for Basketball. The Acc=0 & GT Ans bars are approximately 36 for Movies, 72 for Songs, and 114 for Basketball. The Acc=1 & GT Ans bars are approximately 50 for Movies, 90 for Songs, and 210 for Basketball. The bars are arranged in groups of four, one group per category, and are not sorted within each group. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
